_doc: NIPA Table 6.5D FTE by Industry — Marxian sector classification per Shaikh & Tonak (1994) Appendix F
_note: Use top-level industry lines (not sub-industries) to avoid double-counting. Lines 4,7,11-13,43,52(partial),73-74,79,82,85 = productive. Lines 35,38 = trading. Lines 57,62,65,69,70(partial) = unproductive. Lines 86+ = government.

54.description: Motion picture and sound recording industries

62.description: Real estate and rental and leasing

notes.information_sector: Line 52 (Information) is split: 54 (motion pictures) and 55 (broadcasting/telecom) are productive per SIC 48; 53 (publishing/software) and 56 (data processing) are treated separately. Use sub-lines 54+55 for productive, not the aggregate line 52.
notes.admin_waste: Line 70 (Admin + Waste) is split: 71 (admin/support) is unproductive, 72 (waste management) is productive. Use sub-lines, not aggregate.
notes.government: Lines 87-96 are government sub-lines. Only govt enterprises (91, 96) are classified as productive.
